resources.string: Fast English and phonetic Bangla typing. Offline, no permissions.
Keyboard is enabled, but not selected
You can start typing in any app. Long-press the language key to open these settings.
One more step: pick “Likhon Keyboard” from the keyboard list.
Enable it in system settings, then choose it as your keyboard.
Type here to test the keyboard…
The language key inside the keyboard switches instantly.
Bangla uses phonetic typing: “ami” becomes আমি.
A short tap for every key.
English: start sentences with a capital letter.
Show the Bangla letter on each English key.

Likhon is a small, offline keyboard. It asks for no permissions, has no ads and never sends anything anywhere. English is a standard QWERTY layout; Bangla is phonetic, so you type the sound in English letters.

Type words the way they sound.

ami → আমি
kemon → কেমন
bhalo → ভালো
korbo → করবো
desh → দেশ
kintu → কিন্তু

Capital letters give retroflex and long forms:
T → ট D → ড N → ণ S → ষ R → ড় O → ও I → ঈ U → ঊ

ng → ং ^ → ্ ~ → ঁ . → ।

“o” is silent between consonants (kotha → কথা) and becomes ো at the end of a word (bhalo → ভালো).
